name: Testing Solubility of Common Substances
subject: chemistry
ncert_reference: NCERT textbook portal; exact Class 8 chapter and page to verify
educational_goal: Compare how common solid substances dissolve in water and distinguish soluble from insoluble materials.

scenes.description: A clean table shows identical transparent cups of water labeled for salt, sugar, and sand beside small sample piles.
scenes.image_url: PLACEHOLDER: add a license-reviewed classroom solubility photo

steps.description: Label one transparent cup for each test substance and add the same volume of water.
steps.observation: Each cup starts with a clear, equal-volume water sample.
steps.key_visual: Each cup starts with a clear, equal-volume water sample.

scenes.description: A clean table shows identical transparent cups of water labeled for salt, sugar, and sand beside small sample piles.

steps.description: Add an equal small amount of salt, sugar, or sand to its labeled cup.
steps.observation: The solid is visible in each cup before stirring.
steps.key_visual: The solid is visible in each cup before stirring.

steps.description: Stir each cup for the same amount of time.
steps.observation: Salt and sugar disappear into the water, while sand remains visible and settles.
steps.key_visual: Salt and sugar disappear into the water, while sand remains visible and settles.

scenes.description: A clean table shows identical transparent cups of water labeled for salt, sugar, and sand beside small sample piles.

steps.description: Classify each substance as soluble or insoluble in water.
steps.observation: The results can be compared in a simple observation table.
steps.key_visual: The results can be compared in a simple observation table.
